content.title: Submit an over-limit enterprise order for approval
content.description: A Buyer submits an order whose total including tax and delivery exceeds the per-order spending limit into the approval workflow, sees the over-limit warning on order review, uses Submit for Approval instead of direct placement, and receives a tracked pending request rather than an immediate order.
content.summary: Route an over-limit order into approval.
content.value: Prevents direct purchase above the spending threshold while preserving the order as an approval request.
criteria: A Buyer's per-order spending limit is $25,000, and orders whose total including tax and delivery exceeds that amount require approval.

On order review for an over-limit order, the buyer sees the banner `This order exceeds the $25,000 spending limit and requires Procurement Manager approval.` and the primary action becomes `Submit for Approval` instead of `Place Order`.
Submitting for approval creates a request ID in the format `REQ-` followed by 5 digits with status `Pending Approval`, requester name, total, and submitted time.
